items.source: Specializations of this annotation include @SubscribeMapping (for example, STOMP subscriptions) and @ConnectMapping (for example, RSocket connections). Both narrow the primary mapping further and also match against the message type. Both can be combined with a type-level @MessageMapping that declares a common pattern prefix (or prefixes).
items.translation: 此注解的特化包括 @SubscribeMapping（例如，STOMP 订阅）和 @ConnectMapping（例如，RSocket 连接）。两者进一步细化了主映射，并且还会根据消息类型进行匹配。两者都可以与声明公共模式前缀（或前缀）的类型级 @MessageMapping 结合使用。

items.source: NOTE: When using controller interfaces (for example, for AOP proxying), make sure to consistently put all your mapping annotations - such as @MessageMapping and @SubscribeMapping - on the controller interface rather than on the implementation class.
items.translation: 注意： 在使用控制器接口（例如用于 AOP 代理）时，请确保始终将所有的映射注解——如@MessageMapping和@SubscribeMapping——放在控制器接口上，而不是实现类上。

items.source: for RSocket this is either AntPathMatcher or PathPattern based pattern, depending on which is configured, matched to the route of the stream request.
items.translation: 对于 RSocket，这要么是 AntPathMatcher 或 PathPattern 基于的模式，具体取决于配置的是哪一种，该模式将匹配流请求的路由。

items.source: For STOMP over WebSocket messages this is AntPathMatcher-style patterns matched against the STOMP destination of the message.
items.translation: 对于基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP 消息，这些是类似于 AntPathMatcher 的模式，它们与消息的 STOMP 目标进行匹配。

items.translation: @MessageMapping 方法支持以下参数：

items.source: If no patterns are configured, the mapping matches all destinations.
items.translation: 如果未配置任何模式，映射将匹配所有目标。

items.source: @Payload method argument to extract the payload of a message and have it de-serialized to the declared target type. @Payload arguments may also be annotated with Validation annotations such as @Validated and will then have JSR-303 validation applied. Keep in mind the annotation is not required to be present as it is assumed by default for arguments not handled otherwise.
items.translation: @Payload 方法参数用于提取消息的负载并将其反序列化为声明的目标类型。@Payload 参数还可以使用验证注解（如 @Validated）进行标注，从而应用 JSR-303 验证。请注意，该注解并非必需，因为对于未通过其他方式处理的参数，默认假定其存在。

items.source: @Header method argument to extract a specific message header value and have a Converter applied to it to convert the value to the declared target type.
items.translation: @Header 方法参数用于提取特定的消息头值，并应用一个 Converter 将其转换为声明的目标类型。

items.source: @Headers method argument that is also assignable to Map for access to all headers.
items.translation: @Headers 方法参数，且该参数也可赋值给 Map 以访问所有标头。

items.source: MessageHeaderAccessor method argument for access to all headers. In some processing scenarios, like STOMP over WebSocket, this may also be a specialization such as SimpMessageHeaderAccessor.
items.translation: MessageHeaderAccessor 方法参数用于访问所有标头。在某些处理场景中，例如基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP，这也可能是 SimpMessageHeaderAccessor 这样的特化类。

items.source: STOMP over WebSocket -- the value is turned into a message and sent to a default response destination or to a custom destination specified with an @SendTo or @SendToUser annotation.
items.translation: STOMP over WebSocket -- 该值会被转换为消息并发送到默认响应目的地，或发送到由 `@SendTo` 或 `@SendToUser` 注解指定的自定义目的地。

items.source: @DestinationVariable method argument for access to template variable values extracted from the message destination, for example, /hotels/{hotel}. Variable values may also be converted from String to the declared method argument type, if needed.
items.translation: @DestinationVariable 方法参数用于访问从消息目的地提取的模板变量值，例如 /hotels/{hotel}。如有需要，变量值还可从 String 转换为声明的方法参数类型。

items.source: MessageHeaders method argument for access to all headers.
items.translation: MessageHeaders 方法参数用于访问所有标头。

items.source: Message<T> for access to body and headers with the body de-serialized if necessary to match the declared type.
items.translation: Message<T> 用于访问主体和标头，必要时将主体反序列化为声明的类型。

items.source: Principal method arguments are supported in some processing scenarios such as STOMP over WebSocket. It reflects the authenticated user.
items.translation: Principal 方法参数在部分处理场景中受到支持，例如基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP。它反映了已认证的用户。

items.source: STOMP over WebSocket "Annotated Controllers".
items.translation: WebSocket 上的 STOMP “注解控制器”。

items.source: RSocket "Annotated Responders".
items.translation: RSocket “注解响应器”。

items.source: RSocket -- the response is used to reply to the stream request.
items.translation: RSocket -- 响应用于回复流请求。

items.source: Destination-based mapping expressed by this annotation.
items.translation: 由该注解表示的基于目标的映射。
